For meeting information, contact the City Clerk, 974-2210
The City Council will go into a closed session under Chapter 551 of the Texas Government Code
to receive advice from legal counsel, to discuss matters of land acquisition, to discuss personnel matters,
to discuss or take action on a "competitive matter" of Austin Energy as provided for
under Section 551.086, or for other reasons permitted by law as specifically listed on this agenda.
If necessary, the City Council may go into a closed session as permitted by law regarding any item on this
agenda.
Reading and Action on Consent Agenda
Action on the Following:
Ordinances / Resolutions / Motions -
All of the following items may be acted upon by one motion. No separate discussion or
action on any of the items is necessary unless desired by a Council Member.
2:00 PM -- City Council Convenes
Item(s) to Set Public Hearing(s)
1. 
Set a public hearing to consider an ordinance creating an economic
development program forSUNPOWER CORPORATION and authorizing the
negotiation and execution of an Economic Development Agreement with
SUNPOWER CORPORATION (Suggested date: December 9, 2010, 4:00 p.m. at
Austin City Hall, 301 W. Second Street, Austin, TX).
2:00 PM -- Morning Briefings
2. 
Staff presentation regarding an economic development proposal to create an
economic development program for SUNPOWER CORPORATION.
Adjourn

To: 
City Clerk
From: 
Mayor Lee Leffingwell
Date: 
November 23, 2010
Subject: 
Special Called Meeting
Per Anicle II, Section 10 of the City Charter, this will serve as my written request for a
Special Called Meeting of the Austin City Council to be held on Thursday, December 2,
2010, at 2:00 p.m. at Austin City Hall, Council Chambers, for a Staff presentation
regarding an economic development proposal.
